_: Holtburg's town life (RevivalGuard TownLife.cs, TownLifeRule.cs; docs/findings/holtburg-town-life-2026-11-14.md). The copy beside the mod dll on the shard is the live one: edit it there and it is read again within a minute; no restart. A newer copy built into the mod replaces it at start only if it was not edited here (the old one is kept as TownLife.json.before-<version>); an edited file is kept with a WARN until @townlife reload embedded (admin panel Server: town data). Turbine voice (docs/outreach/VOICE.md): plain ASCII, no em dashes, nothing modern. Points are [x, y, z, cell] in A9B4 metres, cell 'out' or the interior cell (low hex); every leg is checked by tools/townlife/check_legs.py before it ships. A post must match where the NPC really stands (2 m) or its rounds are off. Tokens: {name} {visits} {level} {title} {chronicle}.

lines: a
Buckminster, the corner table wants another round.
b
On my way. Same as before?
a
Same as always.
b
Busy night. The keg is near dry.
a
Then tap the next one, and quickly. Thirsty folk are short-tempered folk.
a
Quiet in here today.
b
Give it till Evensong. They always come in at Evensong.
b
Any luck with the old Redoubt, Worcer?
a
Some. The young ones bring back a piece now and then. It is a start.
b
Here is to them, then.
a
I mean to have a farm of my own by spring.
b
You said that last spring, Alfrin.
a
And I meant it then too.
a
Any new contracts going out today?
b
A few. Fewer coming back finished than I would like.
a
Another boat of new arrivals at the lifestone this morning.
b
Good. Holtburg needs every sword arm it can get.
b
This hem is crooked again.
a
It is straight. Your eyes are crooked.
b
Have you finished copying those ledgers?
a
Nearly. Father would have had them done by noon.
b
Father had help. Get on with it.
a
Do you suppose the Arcanum would lend a few lights for a wedding?
b
The Arcanum lends nothing. But it might sell you some.
a
Your stones hum again tonight.
b
They always hum. You only listen at night.
Worcer, in the back room, wants relics brought out of the old Redoubt to the south. Good work for new hands.
Talk to the Pathwarden by the tavern door before you wander off. He sees new folk properly outfitted.
They say the Training Academy turns out a sharper adventurer than any tavern ever did.
Folk your size go down to the Facility Hub, I hear. The wardens there always want hands.
The wardens of the Facility Hub keep a long list of chores. Steady work, steady pay.
Tuskers. Everyone your size goes after tuskers. The Tusker Barracks are thick with them.
A guard out by Shoushi pays well to see the tuskers thinned. Ask after him.
A fellowship goes further than a lone blade. Find some friends, then try the Matron Hive to the north.
They talk of the Matron Hive North in here. Olthoi, and plenty of them.
Tusker Holding, not the Armory. The Armory looks rich and pays poor, so the regulars say.
The Olthoi Brood Hive keeps the bold busy, I am told.
Creepy Canyons. Half the strong arms in this room have come home from there with full purses.
If you can hold the Creepy Canyons, the regulars say there is no better ground for one of your strength.
The Egg Orchard, and whoever is taking contracts on Olthoi Rippers. Big work for big folk.
The Colosseum's arena master pays well to those who can win there, and often.
Folk of your standing keep a round of old doors that open once a day. Walk them all, then hunt between.
They say Diemos waits for those who have won ten times in the Colosseum.
The Gauntlet is for fellowships, not heroes. Bring friends.
Rand the Game Hunter pays every day for game brought in, whatever your strength.
The factions keep tasks for any who will take them, and they pay by the day.

town.day: Mind the cart ruts by the lifestone.
I could do with a quiet hour.
town.evening: The lamps will be lit soon.
Evensong already. Where does the day go?
Half the town will be in the tavern by now.
town.night: Quiet night. I like it that way.
Mind the dark corners. Not everything out there is a drudge.
town: Holtburg has its faults, but it is home.
news: The Herald cries '{chronicle}' every hour. I could cry it myself by now.
Have you read the notice board? '{chronicle}', it says. Nobody talks of anything else.
role.barkeeper: If you are drinking, sit. If you are not, make room for those who are.
I hear everything in here, sooner or later.
Mind the bench by the hearth. It wobbles.
role.barkeeper.evening: Evensong, and every stool full. Just how I like it.
Another round for the hearth table, and no singing this time.
role.barkeeper.night: Last ones in always stay the longest.
Quiet now. Even the drunks have gone home.
role.server: Who had the stew? Somebody had the stew.
role.server.evening: Busy tonight. My feet will be talking to me tomorrow.
role.patron: Wilomine pours a fair measure. Fairer than Arwic, anyway.
One more, and then home. Probably.
Did you hear about the cow by the well? No? Never mind.
role.patron.evening: Nothing like the tavern at Evensong.
To Holtburg, and to whoever is buying.
role.greeter: If you are new, there is no shame in asking the way.
Holtburg looks after its own. You will see.
role.greeter.night: The lifestone glows brightest at night. Comforting, in its way.
role.herald: News for any who will hear it. Ask, and I will tell.
Hear ye! The roads are open and the town stands.
role.guardsman: Stand straight, recruit. The Crown is watching.
role.townsfolk: I have half a mind to take a walk to Arwic. Only half, mind.
role.shopkeeper: Fair prices, and no haggling before noon.
Look all you like. Touching costs extra.
role.crafter: Good work takes time. Bad work takes longer.
Steady hands. That is the whole of the trade.
role.arcanum: Mind the reagents. Some of them bite.
Magic is patience, mostly. And a little luck.
role.barber: A trim makes the adventurer, I always say.
Sit still and I will make you look like a hero.
role.wedding: Every couple in Dereth deserves a proper wedding.
Flowers, a hall, and two willing hearts. The rest is detail.
npc.dwennon: The cows are watching. Do not look at them.
Three in the east field, standing very still. Too still.
npc.renald_eldest: In my day we walked to Arwic and back before breakfast.
npc.sean: Faster, faster! The road does not run itself.
I have been to Arwic and back since you got here.
npc.ealdred: Have you seen the state of the hair on the new arrivals?
npc.wilomine.fest.frostfell: Spiced wine for Frostfell. Hot, and not too much water in it.
fest.festivalseason: The harvest is in. Even the drudges seem to know it.
Pumpkins on every step. The children carve faces in them.
fest.frostfell: Frostfell again. Keep your feet warm and your mug full.
Snow on the roofs and presents under the trees. Holtburg wears it well.
fest.spring: The maypole is up. Spring has come to Holtburg.
Flowers on every sill. It does the heart good.
fest.wedding: Another year since the Royal Wedding. The Wedding Planner has not stopped smiling.
fest.anniversary: They say Dereth is a year older today. I do not feel it.
fest.newyear: A new year. May it be kinder than the last.
fest.tthuun: Marauders on the roads, they say. Keep your blade close.
fest.scavengerhunt: The Advocates want monster trophies again. Their Herald is by the square.
event.raid: Something is in the town! Get inside!
The guards are calling. Keep back from the road!
event.pkdeath: Blood on the cobbles. Over what, I wonder?
Another one fallen in the street. These are hard days.
event.levelup: Look at you, {name}. Stronger by the day.
There is something new in your step, {name}.
greet.first: Welcome to Holtburg, {name}. Ask if you need anything.
greet.return: Back again, {name}? That is your {visits} visit, by my count.
Ah, {name}. Holtburg missed you. A little.
greet.away: {name}! It has been days. We thought you had gone to Arwic for good.
Look who has come back. Welcome home, {name}.
greet.level.low: Still finding your feet, {name}? We all started somewhere.
greet.level.mid: You are filling out that armor nicely, {name}.
greet.level.high: The drudges must run when they see you coming now, {name}.
greet.level.legend: {name}. They tell stories about you in here, you know.
greet.title: If it is not {name} the {title}. Welcome back.
greet.died: You have the lifestone's chill on you, {name}. Sit a while.
Back from the lifestone, {name}? Happens to the best of us.
reply.night: And to you. Mind the dark.
npc.dwennon.reply: Shh! Not so loud. They can hear you.
kw.rumour.other: Ask Wilomine at the tavern. She hears everything.
Rumours? The tavern is the place for those.
kw.drink: Sit down and I will see what we have.
A drink for the traveller, then.
kw.drink.other: The tavern is that way. Follow the noise.
